campaign_logline: A desperate pilot navigates a collapsing trade corridor.
campaign_pitch: Navigate the decaying infrastructure of the Aurelia Corridor. Balance the demands of three rival factions while uncovering why the supply lines are failing.
campaign_story_summary: The Aurelia Corridor is choking on its own logistics. Zenith wants to secure the main gates, Vanguard seeks to protect trade routes, and Aurelia struggles to maintain their infrastructure. A pilot's cargo becomes a point of contention. You must decide who owns the future of the corridor.
tone: Dry, gritty frontier humor. Low-stakes survival with high-stakes politics.

opening.status_quo: The Aurelia Corridor is a primary trade route between three major hubs.
opening.visible_crisis: Supply lines are failing due to aging gate infrastructure and pirate activity.
opening.hidden_crisis: A logistics software glitch is slowly corrupting the automated navigation systems.
opening.why_now: The nearest hub's main processor is scheduled for a hard reset in thirty days.
opening.player_role: An independent pilot seeking to pay off mounting debts.

mystery.question: Why are the automated navigation systems failing?
mystery.false_answer: Pirates are hacking the gate network to create a dead zone.
mystery.true_answer_hint: The system is reacting to an unforeseen geological shift in the nearby nebula.
mystery.long_term_reveal_direction: The corruption is actually an adaptive response to environmental hazards.

kaelen.secret_angle: She knows the extent of the navigation system's degradation.
kaelen.address_rule: Refer to her as a broker or fix-it specialist.
kaelen.never_reveal_rule: Never reveal her knowledge of the gate systems.

factions.zenith_problem: Zenith seeks to consolidate power by monopolizing the gate network's maintenance.
factions.aurelia_problem: Aurelia is struggling to maintain their aging infrastructure with limited resources.
factions.vanguard_problem: Vanguard wants to secure trade routes against increasing pirate activity.
factions.conflict_triangle: Zenith wants control, Aurelia needs help, and Vanguard wants safety.
factions.neutral_space_pressure: The local pirates are becoming more aggressive as the corridor's security thins.

act_1.name: The Broken Path
act_1.goal: Secure a stable route through the Aurelia Corridor.
act_1.opening_itement_incident: A cargo shipment of gate components is intercepted by a scavenger ship.
act_1.midpoint_turn: You discover that several gates are no longer responding to standard protocols.
act_1.finale: You choose which faction's protocol will be prioritized for the next cycle.
act_1.player_takeaway: The corridor is failing, and you must decide who leads it.

starter_mission.title: Scavenger's Toll
starter_mission.reason: You need to clear a path through a debris-heavy sector.
starter_mission.enemy_knows: The scavenger is trying to hide in the debris.
starter_mission.after_effect: You gain access to a stable gate and a small amount of scrap metal.

recurring_clue.name: Ghost Signals
recurring_clue.signal: A recurring 10-second pulse from an abandoned relay station.
recurring_clue.first__appearance: The first time you enter the gate network.
recurring_clue.escalation: The signal pulses faster as you approach the core of the corridor.
recurring_clue.payoff_hint: The signal is a beacon for automated maintenance drones.

rumor_trail.name: The Shadowy Broker
rumor_trail.hint_theme: Whispers of a broker who can find anything.
clue_templates: I heard she can get you a contract that actually pays well.
She's the told-be-told for fixers in this sector.
rumor_trail.payoff: A high-value contract from Kaelen directly.

horizon.gate_tease: The gate network is expanding into the unknown.
horizon.new__system_reveal_rule: Do not mention other factions until they are encountered.
horizon.future_pressure_tease: Reports of increasing pirate activity in outer sectors.
horizon.future_ore_or_upgrade_tees_tease: Rumors of rare minerals found in the nebula's core.

regeneration_trigger.description: When the first act ends, add new sector gates.
